artworks.title: Five Soldiers and a Turk on Horseback
artworks.description: This artwork depicts a group of five men in different poses. At the center, three individuals stand closely together; one has a slightly bearded face and curly hair under a hat. He wears a draped garment resembling a robe, with hanging sleeves. The man to his right appears engaged in conversation, while the third looks away, wearing a tunic with short sleeves and headwear with a plume. To the left, another man is seated on a horse, holding a long spear, face partially obscured under headgear. In motion, a soldier-like figure with puffed-sleeve shirt and leggings walks forward, carrying a spear on his shoulder. On the right, another individual stands with one leg bent, holding a large polearm, with long hair flowing behind him. The background shows rugged terrain with sparse vegetation, and a horse beside the moving figure.

artworks.title: Neptune's Kingdom
artworks.artist: Jacques de Gheyn II after Willem Danielsz van Tetrode
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular composition featuring mythological sea creatures and figures. The composition is centered around a figure riding a chariot pulled by sea creatures or horses. Surrounding the central scene is an array of figures, including mermaids, tritons, and other mythical sea entities in various poses. The outer circle is filled with flowing lines and textures, embodying the ocean's nature. The shading gives the drawing depth and enhances the scene's quality.

artworks.title: Gulielmus Hogarth
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a seated man facing slightly to the right with his body turned slightly to the left. The man has prominent facial features, including large eyes, a prominent nose, and a closed mouth. He wears a fur hat, a dark coat, and a buttoned shirt with a white collar. A pug dog sits beside him, facing the viewer. Objects like books, an artist's palette, brushes, and a cloth are scattered around them. In the background is a draped curtain, and at the bottom is the inscription "Gulielmus Hogarth."

artworks.title: Characters and Caricaturas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of character profiles and caricatures. The drawing consists of profiles of faces depicted in a stylized manner on one side, and as exaggerated caricatures on the other side. Varying facial expressions and features are shown, with a row dividing the characters and caricatures to illustrate the difference through levels of exaggeration.

artworks.title: Marriage a la Mode: pl.1
artworks.artist: Louis Gerard Scotin after William Hogarth
artworks.description: This is an image of an opulent interior scene with multiple figures engaged in various activities. The setting is richly decorated, showcasing luxury and high social status. It features elaborately dressed individuals involved in a formal or ceremonial event. The room is adorned with large framed paintings and intricate moldings, suggesting an 18th-century style. The detailed rendering of clothing, furniture, and items on the table further emphasize the depiction of a moment in a well-appointed domestic setting.

artworks.title: Marriage a la Mode: pl. 2
artworks.description: This is a painting of a cluttered, opulently decorated interior room. The room is richly decorated with ornate furniture, an intricately designed carpet, and detailed wall moldings. Various objects are scattered on the floor, including a book, musical instrument cases, and sheets of paper. The mantelpiece above the fireplace is crowded with decorative items and is crowned with a painting featuring cherubic figures. The scene is filled with action and possibly humor, as suggested by the arrangement of furniture and items. This is in the style of William Hogarth.

artworks.title: Marriage a la Mode: pl. 3
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals from head to toe. The person on the left is an elderly man in ornate clothing. He gestures towards the woman standing in the center, who wears a bonnet and a detailed dress. The man on the right has long hair and a beard, wearing a long coat. The room is elaborate with anatomical models, a skeleton, a skull, and scientific instruments. A bookshelf with jars and medical objects, a window, and a hat on the floor can also be seen.

artworks.title: Marriage a la Mode: pl.4
artworks.artist: Simon Francois Ravenet I after William Hogarth
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a room with several figures engaged in various activities. The scene includes detailed furnishings and artwork on the walls, people in 18th-century attire interacting, luxurious drapery, a vanity with a mirror, and numerous objects on the floor. The figures are seated on chairs and sofas, engaged in conversation and displaying expressive gestures. The walls are adorned with paintings, and the furniture is intricately designed.

artworks.title: Marriage a la Mode: pl.5
artworks.artist: Simon Francois Ravenet I after William Hogarth
artworks.description: The image shows a room with several individuals in a dramatic scene. A man is depicted leaning back with his arms outstretched. A woman is kneeling on the floor, looking distressed. A uniformed servant is holding a lantern, and another person in night attire appears startled. In the background, a figure is climbing out of a window. The room features an ornate bed, a table with a candle, scattered items like a sword and clothes, and decorative walls.

artworks.title: Marriage a la Mode: pl.6
artworks.artist: Louis Gerard Scotin after William Hogarth
artworks.description: The image portrays a room with five adults. One man is seated to the left, looking down at a table with dishes and a piece of meat being cut by a skeleton. Another man stands next to him. In the center, a man in a dark coat holds a paper and looks at two women to his right, one seated and the other supporting a fainted woman. The seated woman wears a gown and headcover. The background has framed paintings, a bookcase, and a large window showing a canal view. The foreground includes a rug and an overturned chair.

artworks.title: An Election Entertainment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene. The artwork shows a lively interior crowded with figures engaged in various activities around a long banquet table and a round table. Objects like a banner, musical instruments, plates, food, and drinkware are spread throughout the room. Large paintings and a sculpture adorn the walls. A window displays a view of the street with visible figures outside. The scene conveys a sense of lively chaos.

artworks.title: Canvassing for Votes
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling street scene during an election period. The image depicts a crowded outdoor setting where various activities are occurring. There are buildings with balconies and a tree provides shade in the central part of the composition. The painting captures a moment of lively interaction among individuals, with one figure seated at a table with a beverage, and others engaged in conversations or transactions, some with papers in hand. There is also a sign overhead detailing a political campaign and candidates, and in the distance are more figures, some appearing to be marching.

artworks.title: The Polling
artworks.artist: William Hogarth and Francois Morellon de La Cave
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling scene at a polling station. The image shows a crowded gathering of people voting within a wooden structure, while others wait outside. Some are engaged in conversations. In the background, there is a village with a church and a stone bridge over a river. The detailed composition includes a canopy overhead with flags. The style is reminiscent of William Hogarth, known for his detailed and satirical depictions of daily life.

artworks.title: Chairing the Members
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic street scene involving numerous characters and activities. The scene depicts a bustling and disorderly street filled with people engaging in various actions and interactions. The architecture is a mix of buildings with detailed facades and windows, some with people looking through them. There are animals such as a pig and geese. In the foreground, there is a bridge over a canal or river. The general tone of the drawing is one of pandemonium, with an abundance of details and intricate designs capturing the attention of the viewer. The overall style is detailed and illustrative, lending to a narrative quality typical of satirical and moralistic drawings from the 18th century.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.1
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an urban street scene. The illustration features various individuals and activities. The scene depicts a city street with attention to architecture and historical attire. In the foreground, a woman in a bonnet and gown is talking to another similarly dressed woman. A man on horseback is holding a letter and appears to be communicating with a group of seated figures inside a covered cart or stagecoach. Architectural elements, such as a bell and a stone facade, are present. A barrel and square packages or crates are in the bottom right corner. Additional figures are in the background, one looking out from a doorway. The drawing captures a lively depiction of urban life.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.2
artworks.description: This is a painting of an 18th-century interior scene with figures engaged in various activities. The room is ornate, featuring detailed wallpaper and large paintings hanging on the walls. In the center, a man and a woman are seated at a small table; the woman gestures towards the man. To the left, a door opens to reveal two other figures peering into the room. Below, a small dog chews on a broken object on the floor. There are broken pieces of ceramic scattered near the table, and a jug carried by another figure. The entire piece is detailed, suggesting a narrative typical of 18th-century satirical works. This is in the style of William Hogarth, known for his moral and satirical engravings.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.3
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an interior domestic scene with various activities taking place. The image features a room with a four-poster bed, a wooden chair with clothing, framed pictures on the wall, and women engaged in conversation. One woman is using a mortar and pestle with utensils scattered on a table in front of them. In the background, men are entering the scene. Various household items like pots and jugs are placed on the floor, and the drawing emphasizes different textures and details, creating a realistic depiction of daily life.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.4
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a shoe workshop with workers engaged in various activities. The setting suggests a busy environment within a brick-walled building, resembling a cobbler's workshop from an earlier time period.

Full description: The image shows workers involved in different stages of shoe-making and fitting. In the foreground, two women are trying on shoes on a bench. Behind them, a group of onlookers in ornate clothing observe the process or wait their turn. A slogan on the wall reads "Better to Work than Stand thus." Natural light illuminates the scene through the wooden-beamed ceiling, offering a view of the outdoors.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.5
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered room with broken furniture, scattered papers, and debris. At the center, a man appears to be adjusting his collar. To his left, another man is bending over. A woman is gesturing expressively in the background. Various items are scattered around, including a tipped-over ink pot, broken objects, and a fireplace with a fire near a disheveled child. The room shows signs of wear and tear, with a damaged wall and exposed beams. Household items like dishes on a shelf and laundry hanging to dry add to the chaotic and disorderly atmosphere of the room.

artworks.title: A Harlot's Progress: pl.6
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling domestic scene. The image shows a group of people engaged in various activities surrounding a table. On the table, two women are involved in an activity. Surrounding them are others, including a figure watching the activity, one holding a book, and another with an attentive posture. The environment suggests a domestic setting with wooden beams on the ceiling, framed pictures on the walls, and a window on the right side. The textures of the clothing and detailed interior elements hint at a lively atmosphere of collaboration. This is in the style of William Hogarth.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.1
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered room filled with various objects and activities. The scene is set in an indoor environment and includes a cabinet with household items on the left side, a fireplace surrounded by cooking pots and tools, and a mantelpiece with a painting and other objects. People are engaged in various activities, such as adjusting the ceiling and measuring something with a compass. The room is richly decorated, reflecting a chaotic yet lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.2
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a room filled with artwork and music. The detailed interior portrays a group of people engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a man is seated at a keyboard instrument, while a group of people surrounding him is interacting. The room's walls are adorned with framed paintings, adding to the opulence of the environment. The scene conveys a sense of 18th-century elegance and decadence, with rich clothing and elaborate wigs suggesting wealth and sophistication. Each figure in the scene is active, contributing to the lively atmosphere of the gathering.

artworks.title: A Rake's Progress: pl.3
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded interior space with many people engaging in revelry. Various objects can be seen throughout the room, including bottles and instruments. The scene is detailed with lush fabrics and flowing garments, giving a sense of opulence and chaos.
